remarks: Stamford living at it's finest in this 9th floor corner unit condo at Bedford Towers. Private balcony with terrific views of vibrant downtown off of the spacious living room/ dining area. Building features spacious lobby, secure entry and on site superintendent. Affordable HOA covers heat, hot water, gas, water & sewer plus year- round building maintenance. Whether you're looking to owner occupy or invest, this condo checks all of the boxes. Updated throughout with stainless appliances and gas stove. 2 generous bedrooms. Easy access to restaurants, library, train station. I-95, hospital and local shopping. Laundry facilities on the main level, private storage locker. Private rec. room can be reserved. Don't miss this great opportunity! immediate occupancy.
